target.statement: Construct endogenous recursive formation under the original smooth two-sector KL/Fisher dynamics from a nonempty open class of unprepared initial laws: native preferential-attention cliques must develop and persist, two first-stage parents must subsequently form a parent under inherited interactions, and both handoffs must genuinely compress distinct public child-law information while preserving original-time parent dynamics, admitted joint response histories, and nontrivial collective Fisher geometry.
target.quantifiers: There exist fixed normalized constitutive data, positive temperatures, a finite homogeneous population with at least four agents, and a nonempty open subset U of an explicitly declared full regular law domain, such that every initial configuration in U has no preassigned membership tree and exhibits the specified two-stage formation. Openness is in independent law coordinates, not merely inside a common-parameter, equal-score, or supplied-lift submanifold. Finite-alphabet interior laws are an admissible witness in the general-law framework. The contextual geometry claim must hold on a declared regular family through the construction; it is not silently quantified over every possible contextual jet.
domains: General probability laws and normalized Markov kernels on standard Borel spaces; regular dominated domains with finite KL and Fisher scores.
For an explicit finite witness, all independently variable strictly positive belief and model tables with the original within-agent product recognition q_i tensor s_i; no Gaussian restriction.
Smooth contextual sections of the admitted population family, with a declared common gauge action and regular collective orbit stratum.
codomains: State- or accessible-history-selected population partitions and measurable parent configuration states, including their belief/model laws, evaluator, inherited channels, source data and any necessary memory.
Normalized joint response kernels and autonomous original-time parent vector fields; compatible collective minimizing connection classes and contextual tensors.
target.regularity: Original smooth KL potential and complete Fisher natural gradient with equal unit mobilities, or its exactly Gibbs-reduced version. Normalized channels are at least C2 in the law coordinates and their compared laws are strictly positive; the kernels themselves may be deterministic identity kernels. Local unique interior flows are required. Stronger analytic or global-existence assumptions must be labeled as route-specific.
measures: Declared dominating measures for every density and product recognition, with supports, absolute continuity and integrability stated.
No distribution over law configurations is assumed unless a stochastic preparation or record protocol is explicitly added.
boundary_conditions: Formation events occur at finite regular interior times; approximation, asymptotic limits and singular boundary events are separate possible partial results.
No resets, added fusion penalty, prescribed hierarchy, newly tuned next-level attraction, or constitutive flat erasure gate.
symmetries: Population relabeling covariance with no block labels hidden in fixed data.
Passive gauge covariance of laws and channels; a stated common gauge action for collective geometry.
target.equivalence: Exact equality of retained initial states and original-time evolution, all finite adaptive joint histories in one predeclared response class, and collective minimizing connection classes and contextual tensors in the same Fisher normalization. Each handoff must forget a continuous nongauge public-law distinction after all retained event times and memory are included. Merely packaging the entire child tuple or its identifiable empirical law is not compression.
premises: The fixed source is the live MAgent_Theory_2.0 potential and full derivative, including all receiver, sender and law-dependent channel terms.
Positive normalized source priors and temperatures are fixed; exact Gibbs rows are admissible, while prior learning or inserted slow mobilities change the model.

Preferential-attention clique means a nontrivial block with a specified strict native routing-mass contrast against its complement for a stated persistence interval; exact zero leakage is not required. The threshold and tie treatment must be declared and used consistently at both levels.
Source channels and response protocols may be specified once as constitutive data, but their sufficiency, descent and recursive compatibility must be proved rather than assumed.
No finite-dimensional, finite-memory, Gaussian or all-context-jets restriction is imposed on an exact parent. Any retained enlargement must still meet the genuine-information-loss requirement.
permitted_theorems: Uniqueness and continuous dependence for locally Lipschitz ODEs with their hypotheses checked.
Conditional expectation score projection and KL chain rules on regular dominated standard Borel models.
Exact lumpability and analytic continuation only on explicitly established domains.
target.falsification_criterion: A complete negative result requires a nonexistence proof for the entire existential target. A counterexample to a chosen retention, an analytic-subclass obstruction, or failure of one architecture is only a scoped result; it does not close this target.
target.literature_policy: Read local manuscripts and prior investigations first. Consult primary papers and official scholarly sources through bounded web search for exact closure, formation, or sufficiency mechanisms. Follow a source only while it resolves a named mathematical obligation; no worldwide novelty claim. No Lean or GPU work. At most three substantive constructive rounds and stop earlier after two rounds without a new checkable result.
